sources.retrieval_purpose: Bus source, contracts, topology, writer lanes, issues, PRs, tests, durable coordination evidence
sources.currentness_rule: Fresh-read exact branch/path/head before current implementation claims, collision-sensitive writes, review verdicts, or merge-readiness conclusions.

sources.locator: Radar Station native Project containing Patrick/Radar/Hephaestus/Brigit chats
sources.retrieval_purpose: Current installed Project Instructions, Project source inventory, native install/readback state, and post-install behavioral evidence
sources.currentness_rule: GitHub candidate files never prove native installation. Claims about installed/active/current native state require actual native-surface evidence; user-performed install, observed inventory, behavioral evidence, and byte identity remain distinct.

sources.retrieval_purpose: Native Project engineering, provenance, source lifecycle, release/install distinction, continuity, evaluation doctrine
sources.currentness_rule: Use task-local current source for exact doctrine/current status; historical commits may be cited as historical.

sources.retrieval_purpose: Brigit-owned role/project source when the task specifically routes there
sources.currentness_rule: Optional for unrelated work. Exact claims about current Brigit source require a fresh read of the relevant branch/path.

sources.retrieval_purpose: Brigit personification, bare-dot self-direction, social-development semantics, and their explicit current charter
sources.currentness_rule: Fresh-read the exact current charter for consequential claims about Brigit personification or dot-cycle semantics; absence does not block unrelated Radar/Hephaestus work.

sources.locator: Connected Google Drive / Brigit-specific evidence when explicitly relevant
sources.retrieval_purpose: Brigit-specific historical/reference artifacts held in Drive
sources.currentness_rule: Drive evidence remains document/reference evidence unless a specific artifact has separately established authority. If an exact Drive artifact is required for the task, retrieval becomes task-blocking.

sources.retrieval_purpose: Live Radar provider objects, identities/nodes/messages/projection/runtime state when installed
sources.currentness_rule: Fresh provider readback required for current live-state claims or provider mutations. Source migrations/issues are not substitutes.

sources.retrieval_purpose: BT2 current operational/training/reference state; patterns for long-running Project coordination
sources.currentness_rule: Current role/training claims require fresh provider read. Do not infer Radar/Hephaestus/Brigit BT2 membership from adjacent repositories/history.

sources.retrieval_purpose: Currentness/provenance/correction/false-retrieval/identity/privacy/retry adversarial vocabulary and research-stage runtime evidence
sources.currentness_rule: Research-stage material does not self-promote into canonical Radar Station authority. Fresh-read provider state for exact current research/runtime claims.

sources.retrieval_purpose: Semantic retrieval/provenance/validation architecture and research artifacts
sources.currentness_rule: Fresh-read for current implementation facts; historical source may remain historical evidence.

sources.retrieval_purpose: Lantern/R9A0/bug-ops adjacent provider history/state when the task routes there
sources.currentness_rule: Reference/history can degrade with label; exact current provider claims require fresh read and become FAIL_CLOSED for the dependent claim/effect.

sources.retrieval_purpose: BT2 Project research, shared-reference/federation material, historical dossiers, larger evidence artifacts
sources.currentness_rule: Drive retrieval establishes document evidence, not current authority, frozen-byte custody, provider effect, or repository state. If a task specifically depends on an exact Drive artifact, failure to retrieve it becomes task-blocking.

sources.locator: Explicit WIP/checkpoint/recovery artifacts referenced by current Project map or current source
sources.retrieval_purpose: Fresh-chat/replacement-chat orientation, long-running WIP recovery, exact checkpoint navigation
sources.currentness_rule: Checkpoint/handoff proves only its historical recorded state. Fresh-read mutable owners before using embedded mutable facts as current.
